scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm -w @berry-agent/claw-server run dev" "npm -w @berry-agent/claw-client run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w @berry-agent/claw-contracts run build && npm -w @berry-agent/claw-server run build && npm -w @berry-agent/claw-client run build
scripts.build:desktop: npm -w @berry-agent/claw-contracts run build && npm -w @berry-agent/claw-desktop run build
scripts.build:mobile: npm -w @berry-agent/claw-contracts run build && npm -w @berry-agent/claw-mobile run build
scripts.release:check: npm run build && npm test && npm -w @berry-agent/claw-mobile run build && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=@berry-agent/claw-contracts --workspace=@berry-agent/claw-server
